description: Two attenuverters in 4HP, each scaling a signal and adding a steady voltage to it

params.text: Scales the signal on that row, -1 to +1, so the lower half of its travel inverts the signal
Adds a steady voltage to that row, -10V to +10V

inputs.text: Added to the ATTN knob on that row, -10V to +10V covering -1 to +1
Added to the OFFSET knob on that row, volt for volt
The signal that row scales and offsets

outputs.text: The scaled and offset signal for that row, held between -10V and +10V
